I am a Ph.D. student in Public Policy and Political Economy at the University of Texas at Dallas. My research focuses on climate change policy, inequality, vulnerable populations, and local government.

## Research Interests

- Climate Change Policy
- Inequality and Vulnerable Populations
- Local Government
